summary: Iteration 2 testing of UltimateArbitrageHFT new features: Cloudflare Worker HTTPX bridge with mock fallback, MongoDB persistence for trades/logs, and encrypted per-exchange API-key manager. Backend: 17/17 pytest checks PASSED (worker health surface, mock-fallback source labels, /trades/history & /logs/history persistence, /exchange-keys CRUD with validation + masked output + Fernet encryption verified directly in MongoDB). Frontend: full e2e flow PASSED - login, sidebar 'API Keys' nav, worker-status-pill shows 'worker · 403' (expected because ecostamp.net returns Cloudflare 1014), all 7 exchange cards rendered, Add Bybit (no passphrase) saves & shows LINKED + masked, KuCoin Add shows passphrase input and saves, delete auto-accepts confirm() and returns card to NOT SET, regression sweep across Dashboard/Spreads/Trades/Wallet/Config/Logs/Telegram all render cleanly. Mongo verification confirms api_key_enc/api_secret_enc store ciphertext only (no plaintext leak), db.trades and db.engine_logs populate as the engine runs.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js has a DUPLICATE route declaration: <Route path="/keys"> is declared twice — first to <ApiKeys/> (line 38) and again to <Keys/> (line 40). React Router uses the first match so functionality works, but the second route + the unused import of './pages/Keys' are dead code and should be removed for clarity.

server.py background_tick + worker_probe_loop tasks are created in on_event('startup') without cancellation on shutdown — fine for now, but on graceful shutdown they will be orphaned. Consider FastAPI lifespan + task cancellation.
worker_client._client (AsyncClient) is never closed; acceptable for a long-running server but worth noting.
server.py is ~590 lines; getting close to the 700-line split threshold — consider modularising routers (auth, bot, market, keys, telegram) as the app grows.

/api/trades and /api/logs use 'if limit <= len(buffer)' as the short-circuit; if buffer has fewer entries than limit it falls through to Mongo which is correct, but the condition reads inverted at a glance — consider renaming for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows incl. worker pill, add/edit/delete keys, passphrase modal, nav regression)

seed_data_creation: Test inserted+deleted KuCoin (api), Bybit (UI), and MEXC (mongo verification) exchange-keys docs during the run. All cleaned up; only Binance (pre-existing from prior session) remains in db.exchange_keys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (worker bridge fallback, persistent trades/logs, encrypted API key manager) verified e2e. Worker at https://ecostamp.net returns Cloudflare 1014 (403) which is the EXPECTED dev-time state — mock fallback path is active. If next iteration swaps WORKER_URL to a live worker that returns 2xx, /api/bot/status etc will switch to source='worker' and the worker-status-pill will turn green ('worker · live'). The duplicate /keys route in App.js should be cleaned up but does not affect functionality.
